test_TeleporterTest_test_movement: test the TeleporterTest class and its test_movement method that verifies teleporter behavior in a deepmind_lab environment
create_lab_environment: create a deepmind_lab.Lab environment with observation channels VEL.TRANS, DEBUG.POS.TRANS, and DEBUG.POS.ROT
run_lab_step: run an environment step with an action array and timestep to advance the simulation
get_lab_observations: get environment observations including velocity, position, and rotation from the deepmind_lab environment
check_lab_events: check environment events such as PLAYER_TELEPORTED after stepping through the simulation
